# Synthetic todoq compatibility fixtures

All names, URLs, requests and commands here are invented. No private queue body
or installation configuration is included. The four family configurations vary
one verified dialect: batch, shifts, legacy prefix and incomplete mappings.

Structural reference: `neverhuman/nightshift-todo-driver` commit
`b26ddcbfc12e6be527093dd3afa3e63040c03d1a`, `todoq/todoq/queue.py`
(`load_family`) and `todoq/todoq/todo.py` (`load`). Supplied Git identities
remain claims; only supplied raw bytes/digests are checked by this pure parser.
Imported setup/gate/notes and Markdown remain inert data.
